description: A comprehensive 31-day cohort covering modern AI engineering, from foundational ML to production-grade agentic systems.

days.description: Advanced Python patterns for AI: async programming, type hints, decorators, generators, and performance profiling for ML workloads.
Core ML concepts: supervised vs unsupervised learning, bias-variance tradeoff, cross-validation, and evaluation metrics.
Data cleaning pipelines, handling missing data, feature scaling, encoding categorical variables, and feature selection techniques.
Neural network architectures, backpropagation, activation functions, loss functions, and optimization algorithms.
Text preprocessing, tokenization, word embeddings (Word2Vec, GloVe), TF-IDF, and sentiment analysis pipelines.
Self-attention mechanism, multi-head attention, positional encoding, encoder-decoder architecture, and the evolution from RNNs to Transformers.
GPT architecture, training paradigms (pre-training, fine-tuning, RLHF), scaling laws, emergent abilities, and model evaluation.
Zero-shot, few-shot, chain-of-thought prompting, prompt templates, system prompts, and structured output generation.
Text embeddings, embedding models (OpenAI, Cohere, Sentence-Transformers), cosine similarity, and semantic search pipelines.
FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma — indexing strategies (HNSW, IVF), metadata filtering, and hybrid search.
RAG architecture, chunking strategies, retrieval pipelines, context window management, and hallucination mitigation.
Multi-step retrieval, hypothetical document embeddings (HyDE), parent-child chunking, recursive retrieval, and evaluation (RAGAS).
Chains, prompt templates, output parsers, memory modules, and building composable LLM applications with LangChain.
Custom chains, tool integration, routing chains, streaming responses, and LangChain Expression Language (LCEL).
OpenAI function calling, tool schemas, parallel tool use, structured extraction, and building reliable tool-using agents.
Agent architectures (ReAct, Plan-and-Execute), reasoning loops, tool selection, and agent memory patterns.
Agent orchestration, communication protocols, supervisor patterns, debate frameworks, and CrewAI/AutoGen architectures.
MCP architecture, server/client implementation, resource management, tool exposure, and building MCP-compliant services.
LoRA, QLoRA, full fine-tuning, dataset preparation, hyperparameter selection, and evaluation of fine-tuned models.
Automated evaluation metrics, human evaluation protocols, A/B testing, red-teaming, and building evaluation pipelines.
Input/output guardrails, content filtering, prompt injection defense, rate limiting, and responsible AI deployment.
Server-Sent Events, WebSocket integration, token streaming, real-time transcription, and low-latency inference patterns.
Microservices for AI, API gateway patterns, queue-based processing, caching strategies, and scalable inference serving.
AWS SageMaker, containerized deployments (Docker/ECS), serverless inference (Lambda), and GPU instance management.
ML pipeline orchestration, model versioning, experiment tracking (MLflow/W&B), automated testing, and deployment pipelines.
LLM observability (LangSmith, Helicone), token usage tracking, latency monitoring, error tracking, and cost optimization.
Graph databases (Neo4j), knowledge graph construction, entity extraction, graph-based RAG, and ontology design.
Vision-language models, image generation (DALL-E, Stable Diffusion), audio processing, and multimodal RAG pipelines.
Bias detection, fairness metrics, model interpretability (SHAP, LIME), data privacy (GDPR), and AI governance frameworks.
Design and build a production-grade AI application integrating RAG, agents, evaluation, guardrails, and deployment.
Mock interviews, system design for AI, behavioral questions, portfolio presentation, and career strategy for AI engineers.
